title.zh: 将审计长年薪定为一万五千比索的法案
title.en: An Act to Fix the Salary of the Auditor General At Fifteen Thousand Pesos Per Annum.
title.orig: An Act to Amend Commonwealth Act Numbered Five Hundred Thirty-two, Entitled "An Act to Fix the Salary of the Auditor General At Fifteen Thousand Pesos Per Annum."

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_904_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 1 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en:
Section one of Commonwealth Act Numbered hundred thirty-two is hereby amended so as to read as follows:
“
The Auditor General shall receive an annual salary of sixteen thousand pesos.”

The amount necessary to carry out the provision of this Act for the rest of the fiscal year ending June thirty, nineteen hundred fifty-three, shall be taken from the savings of the appropriation for the General Auditing Office for said fiscal year.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1953.
